items.title: Coinbase (COIN) Keeps Circle Partnership Terms Unchanged As USDC Renewal Kicks In
items.summary: Coinbase Global and Circle confirmed that their commercial partnership will renew automatically on the same terms. The update ends speculation that the USDC agreement might be renegotiated following Coinbase's entry into the Open USD consortium. The renewal maintains existing economics around USDC for Coinbase without announced changes to revenue sharing. Coinbase Global, ticker NasdaqGS:COIN, is trading at $146.5, with the stock down 12.7% over the past week and 11.5% over the past month...
